===The statues===
{{Checklist|* Talk to Ellamaria, ask about the statues to get a trolley.}}
'''''Lumbridge Castle'''''

{{Checklist|* Use the trolley on the statue of a king.
* Push the trolley east over the bridge.
* Place the statue on the eastern plinth in the garden.}}

'''''Falador Square'''''

{{Checklist|* Use the trolley on the Saradomin statue.
* Push the trolley north through the gate.
* Watch the cutscene.
* Place the  statue on the southern plinth in the garden.}}
